verdict.rationale: Kushki's own docs include a 'Test Data ... Moving to Production' section. That implies a separate test environment and a promotion step before live traffic, so payments can be exercised without touching production. The evidence is only a page title, though, with no detail on how the sandbox is isolated, on test credentials or endpoints, or on how well it matches production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sandbox environment and endpoints, separate test API keys, details on test card data and simulated scenarios, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
